## Objective

Replace legacy tests and prove source behavior, safety, migration, and downstream handoff before adoption.

## Scope

- V1 and v2 fixtures
- Lifecycle and CLI tests
- Migration tests
- Safety regressions

- PHASE-005 package content and metadata are internally consistent.

- The complete source suite passes.
- Compile and structural validation pass.
- An isolated To-Implementation-Plan intake preserves TRD identity and authority.

## Risks

- Tests could mirror implementation without asserting protected bytes.
- Integration checks could accidentally touch real catalogs.
